'''Barga''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who served in the [[Brak Sector Force]]. He was one of the original rebels in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] who was part of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]]'s force before their alliance with the Rebels.
